entries.note: Contract-manifest schema discriminator.
Human-facing bundle identifier.
entries.reason: No independent bundle-id authority exists; the sealed member identities are enforced instead.

entries.note: Human-facing expected-table producer identifier.
entries.reason: The gate does not consume this manifest field; producer identities in generated evidence are separate values.

entries.note: Narrative authority for the expected-table producer role.
entries.reason: This is a human-review claim with no independent machine-readable authority.

entries.note: Narrative identity of the expected-table author.
entries.reason: Authorship independence is a human-review claim and is not derivable from repository bytes.

entries.note: Narrative owner ruling supporting authorship independence.
entries.reason: The source ruling is not installed as a machine-verifiable repository artifact.

entries.note: Expected-value provenance declaration consumed by the gate.
Pinned design metadata consumed by the gate.
Dated repository identity captured by an earlier authoring lane.
entries.rule: A stale repository identity must be explicitly labelled captured-at or historical and must not claim present-session currency.

entries.note: Narrative count-and-authority summary for the catalog.
entries.reason: The gate measures the live catalog independently but does not compare this summary object.

entries.note: Closed list of sealed expected members.
Narrative byte-format claim.
entries.reason: The gate checks relevant member bytes through parsing and digests but does not prove every narrative assertion in this field.

entries.note: Narrative meanings assigned to blocked-cell markers.
entries.reason: The gate consumes marker tokens elsewhere but does not compare this explanatory object to an independent authority.

entries.note: Narrative pin and summary for the applicability source.
entries.reason: The field is not consumed by the gate and its external authority is not independently installed here.

entries.note: Narrative owner-addendum source record.
entries.reason: The cited external source is not a machine-verifiable repository authority.

entries.note: Append-only dated manifest revision journal.
entries.rule: Existing dated entries are immutable; later revisions may only append a new entry.

entries.note: Duplicate live seal state maintained beside the canonical seal object.
entries.rule: Its seal and implementation-base identities must equal the canonical seal and anchor identities.

entries.note: Declared state of the mandatory semantic-coverage review.
entries.rule: It must not claim the review is unperformed when a validating semantic-coverage receipt is installed.

entries.note: Narrative limit on claims made by the bundle.
entries.reason: This safety statement is for human interpretation and has no independent structured authority.

entries.note: Canonical expected seal consumed by the gate.
Seal transition history partly consumed for owner-ratification ordering.
Legacy event-order pin consumed by the comparison pipeline.
Implementation-anchor schema discriminator.
entries.reason: The gate authenticates whole anchor bytes through the sidecar but does not interpret this schema field.

entries.note: Narrative note describing the original anchor workflow.
entries.reason: The text is not consumed and has no structured source of truth.

entries.note: Anchor copy of the expected bundle seal.
Anchor implementation-base identity.
Live end of the base-repin core-tree chain.
entries.rule: It must equal the final new core-tree identity in base_repin_history.

entries.note: Original external authoring path for the expected bundle manifest.
entries.reason: This is legacy workflow provenance; the repository-local manifest is the live input.

entries.note: Declared kernel write-path scope.
entries.reason: Authorization scope is owner- and Lead-governed; this standalone validator does not grant or re-evaluate it.

entries.note: Declared evidence paths for design rows 14 through 18.
entries.reason: The gate has independent evidence-path checks but does not consume this anchor list.

entries.note: Narrative Lead acceptance record.
entries.reason: Acceptance is a human governance act and cannot be inferred by this checker.

entries.note: Anchor copy of the seal transition chain.
entries.rule: Every adjacent old/new seal transition must be continuous and the final value must equal the live anchor seal.

entries.note: Anchor copy of the legacy event-order-map digest.
Implementation-base and core-tree transition chains.
entries.rule: Both old/new identity chains must be continuous and end at the live anchor identities.

entries.note: Narrative provenance statement containing a measured tracked-path count.
entries.rule: Every asserted integer count of tracked paths under tests/corrected_vnext must equal git ls-files.

entries.note: Path of the pinned design bytes used by design cross-checks.
entries.rule: The file must be readable so its title version, change log, and heading positions can be measured.

entries.note: Declared design version.
entries.rule: It must equal the version parsed from line 1 of the pinned design with the gate regex.

entries.note: Line-number map for headings measured at re-seal 17.
entries.rule: Every declared heading must occur exactly once at its declared current line.

entries.note: Duplicate seal identity in seal_state.
entries.rule: It must equal manifest.seal.EXPECTED_SEAL_SHA.

entries.note: Canonical manifest seal identity.
Duplicate implementation-base identity in seal_state.
entries.rule: It must equal the canonical manifest seal base and the anchor base.

entries.note: Canonical manifest implementation-base identity.
Predecessor seal identity in each manifest re-seal transition.
entries.rule: Every non-genesis predecessor must be produced by the chain and each adjacent transition must agree.

entries.note: Successor seal identity in each manifest re-seal transition.
entries.rule: Every successor must feed the next transition and the final successor must equal the live seal.

entries.note: Predecessor seal identity in each anchor re-seal transition.
entries.rule: Every non-genesis predecessor must be produced by the chain and each adjacent transition must agree.

entries.note: Successor seal identity in each anchor re-seal transition.
entries.rule: Every successor must feed the next transition and the final successor must equal the live anchor seal.

entries.note: Predecessor commit in each base-repin transition.
entries.rule: Every non-genesis predecessor must be produced by the base chain and adjacent transitions must agree.

entries.note: Successor commit in each base-repin transition.
entries.rule: Every successor must feed the next transition and the final successor must equal the live anchor base.

entries.note: Predecessor core-tree identity in base-repin transitions.
entries.rule: Every non-genesis transition must declare the prior core-tree identity and adjacent transitions must agree.

entries.note: Successor core-tree identity in base-repin transitions.
entries.rule: Every successor must feed the next transition and the final successor must equal core_tree_oid_at_base.

entries.note: Structured status of the Section-16 review.
entries.rule: It must not be pending or unperformed when a validating semantic-coverage receipt is installed.

entries.note: Pinned identity of the baseline manifest used for the legacy event-order map.
entries.rule: Its digest must match the live file at its stated path or the object must explicitly label itself historical.
